allowed_source_cidrs.description: CIDRs allowed to reach SSH and MUD proxy ports. Required; no default.

allowed_tcp_ports.description: TCP ports the MUD proxy listens on (opened to allowed_source_cidrs).

availability_domain_strategy.description: Placement strategy: 'spread' distributes instances across ADs round-robin; 'single' puts all in AD[0]. Use 'single' for single-AD regions.

boot_volume_gb.description: Boot volume size in GB per instance (default 50 GB × 4 = 200 GB Always Free limit).

compartment_ocid.description: OCID of the compartment where all resources will be created.

environment.description: Environment label applied to all resource tags (e.g. prod, dev).

install_tintin.description: Install tintin++ MUD client on each instance via cloud-init.

instance_count.description: Number of A1 Flex instances to create (1–4; Always Free cap is 4 total OCPUs / 24 GB).

memory_gb_per_instance.description: Memory in GB per A1 Flex instance.

mud_upstream_host.description: Hostname or IP of the upstream MUD/game server.

mud_upstream_port.description: TCP port of the upstream MUD/game server.

ocpu_per_instance.description: OCPU count per A1 Flex instance.

project_tag.description: Value for the 'project' freeform tag applied to all resources.

public_subnet_cidr.description: CIDR block for the regional public subnet.

ssh_public_key.description: SSH public key material placed in authorized_keys on each instance.
